children: Vroom announced two financing actions to bolster liquidity and funding. United Auto Credit, its subsidiary, closed an auto ABS backed by approximately $292.1 million of subprime receivables, issuing $234.2 million of fixed-rate notes across Classes A–E via United Auto Credit Securitization Trust 2026-2. The notes pay interest monthly and amortize until paid in full, providing long-term, non-recourse capital. Separately, Vroom increased commitments under its Senior Secured Delayed Draw Convertible Notes due 2032 to $60 million, with incremental commitments from Mudrick Capital Management and Annox Capital, leaving other terms unchanged.
